# Paravoxia — orchestration & token discipline

Fable weekly limits are the binding constraint; most spend is long-context
cache reads, not output. Every session in this repo follows these rules.

## Model tiering (frontmatter already set — don't override upward casually)

- **fable (inherit)**: `chapter-director`, `score-director`,
  `cinematography-director`, `story-alignment-judge`,
  `scene-cohesion-judge` — creative build and taste-critical judgment only.
- **opus**: `story-naive-reader`, `story-canon-auditor`, `story-verifier`,
  `scene-naive-viewer`, `cinematography-continuity-auditor`,
  `score-continuity-auditor`, `player-experience-auditor` — blind reading,
  auditing, and mechanical verification.
- Any ad-hoc Explore/general-purpose agent for searching, doc-reading, log
  triage, or probe-running: pass `model: "opus"` (or `"haiku"` for trivial
  greps). A mechanical subagent must never inherit fable.

## Main-session context hygiene

- Stay an orchestrator. Don't pull the design corpus (~65k tokens:
  `PARAVOXIA_PROGRESSION.md`, `PARAVOXIA_CH4_PLAN.md`, `main/STORY.md`) into
  the main context unless doing the creative work directly here — delegate
  reading to a subagent and keep only its conclusions.
- Verification (movie probes, screenshot strips, `npm run verify`) goes to
  `story-verifier`, not inline Bash loops. Run dev servers and long probes in
  the background; read back tails, never full logs.
- Guided-play changes require both the verifier's objective/marker/feedback
  lifecycle proof and a fresh read-only `player-experience-auditor` report.
  Neither role patches or substitutes for a creative director.
- After finishing a chapter or review, remind the owner to `/clear` before the
  next task; suggest `/compact` before starting a long build phase when
  context is already large.

## This machine runs concurrent sessions

Other agents and the owner work in this repo at the same time. Two incidents in
one session on 2026-09-04:

- A parallel refactor of `main/src/utils/fauna*.ts` landed mid-`verify` and made
  it fail on files the running session had never touched. **Before treating a
  gate failure as yours, check `ls -l` timestamps against your last edit.** Do
  not "fix" a module someone is actively splitting — you will collide with work
  whose destination only they know.
- A probe pointed at `127.0.0.1:5199` measured a DIFFERENT PROJECT after that
  port was taken over. It returned 200 and rendered a real app, so nothing
  looked wrong. **Probes must verify identity, not liveness** — check for
  `<title>Paravoxia</title>` before trusting a measurement. `npm run
  verify:visual` picks a free port and does this check; copy that pattern.

`npm run dev` fails here with `ENOSPC: System limit for number of file watchers
reached` (the `captures/` tree is enormous). Use `npm run build` plus
`npx vite preview`.

Two more harness traps, both hit on 2026-09-04:

- **A background shell that waits with `until ! pgrep -f "<name>"` waits forever**,
  because the pattern matches the waiting shell's own command line. Use the
  bracket trick — `pgrep -f "[n]ame"` — or run dependent steps sequentially in
  one shell instead of polling.
- **Probes must own their server's lifetime.** Nine orphaned `vite preview`
  processes were left behind by probes that crashed. `tools/lib/previewServer.mjs`
  now kills the child on exit/signal; use it rather than spawning a preview by
  hand. Its `assertHardwareGl` check is also mandatory: without `--use-gl=angle`
  headless Chromium here silently used SwiftShader and a boot profile showed a
  20-second stall that the real GPU never produces.
- **Probe switches** (players never set these): `?worldprep=sync` forces the legacy
  synchronous world generation; `?beatregistry=off` serves the legacy story tables
  instead of beat contracts. Both exist so a baseline and a candidate come from ONE build.
- **Edit-then-measure ordering.** A build started 27 seconds after a source edit
  contains that edit. Capture a baseline BEFORE changing the code path it
  measures, or use the same-build A/B switches (`?worldprep=sync`,
  `?beatregistry=off`) so baseline and candidate come from one build.

## Creative triad

For any new scene, awakening, substantial cutscene recut, or audiovisual
polish pass, invoke the `creative-triad` skill. The Chapter, Score, and
Cinematography directors are peers. They communicate through the run's scene
contract and structured director notes; they do not race edits in shared
timeline files or approve their own implementation.

Chapter, Score, and Cinematography are exactly the three peer creative
directors. Auditors, verifiers, judges, and integration engineers provide
checks, evidence, and repair routing; they never become a fourth creative lane.

Durable contracts live in:

- `PARAVOXIA_CREATIVE_COUNCIL.md`
- `main/CINEMATOGRAPHY.md`
- `main/src/story/ux/README.md` (the executable player-guidance context
  contract for objective, marker, HUD, and feedback lifecycles)
- `docs/architecture/workflow-orchestration/examples/paravoxia-creative-triad.workflow.json`
- `.codex/production-runs/_template/`

## Story scope

Post-arrival story work is **authorized**. The owner lifted the post-arrival
gate on 2026-07-28 (recorded at the top of `PARAVOXIA_DEMO_FOUNDATION_PLAN.md`):
story beyond `ch9-hearth` may be designed, built, and registered, including the
space-station chapter. Do not refuse or defer this work on the basis of an
older freeze — earlier revisions of this file carried one, and it expired.

What still applies:

- **Creative-Triad and registry gates are the remaining barrier** between a new
  chapter and the runtime. Route the work through them; do not route around.
- **Sequencing is owner-directed: do not rush to the station.** Making the
  existing story enjoyable comes first, and the need to leave must emerge from
  play rather than from a new content hook.
- **The demo's release surface is unchanged** — it still stops at
  `ch4-arrival`, and publishing remains a separate decision. Building past it
  is allowed; shipping it in the demo is not implied.
- **Shipped copy and audio remain protected baselines.** Changing a protected
  audio/runtime path is still a contracted change, not an incidental one.
- **"Anchorage" is retired as a name.** The location is the **space station**.

# Common Ground integration survey

Status: source reconnaissance on 2026-09-06. No runtime edits, build, test, browser probe, or creative approval was performed by this survey. The candidate remains the directors' responsibility. Standing owner authority permits in-scope integration decisions after the signed candidate; this document does not claim that the owner inspected later artifacts.

## Main finding

The smallest safe feature implementation is a chapter-local state/commit module, a world component, beat contracts and player-input rails, and small connections to current shared owners. Two seams need explicit work before a complete continuation can be claimed: the formal registry currently ends at ch10 while the station/return sidecar already uses ch11/ch12 receipts; the movie currently stops inside the station after acquiring its cell.

Preserve chapter numbers already embedded in saves. Use ch13 for the proposed next formal chapter unless the signed council supplies another non-colliding ID. Registry `order` is array position, not a chapter's number: appending a sole ch13 to the present formal sequence would give it order 11. That alone does not solve the missing station/return boundary.

All paths below are relative to `/home/thomasphillip/Projects/vox`. Conclusions derive from the current source, including untracked refactor modules, rather than historical ownership comments.

## Current extension owners

| Concern | Current owner and required connection |
| --- | --- |
| Beat identity and resume | `main/src/story/storyState.ts`: `StoryChapter`, `StoryBeat`, `STORY_BEAT_ORDER`, `STORY_MILESTONES`, `storyEntryPoint`, `stageForStoryPoint`, `seedForBeat`, `initStoryFromSave`, `beginStory`, `restartStory`, `reactivateStoryAtBeat`. New resume clauses must precede `ch10Complete`, which currently returns immediately to `done`. Keep `done` last. Explicitly return `alive` for the new chapter; otherwise it falls through to `bare`. |
| Authored beat behavior | `main/src/story/beats/<chapter>/<beat>.ts`: `defineBeat` supplies objective, input, HUD ownership, rail timeout/wait text/tick, marker resolver, and journey rows. `BeatContract` does not own gameplay tick/enter callbacks or save data. Model the entry contract as `reactivation-from-done` where appropriate. |
| Generated views | `main/tools/chapter-registry-generate.mjs` scans only `prologue`/`ch<number>` directories for `export const beat… = defineBeat(`; filenames must equal beat IDs and IDs must occur in `STORY_BEAT_ORDER`. It generates chapter `index.ts` and `definitions.ts`, then `generate-beat-views.ts` generates `metadata.generated.ts`, registry beat lists and journey objective lists. It does **not** add new chapter records to either JSON, nor add the new chapter import to `beats/index.ts`. Its `emit` calls `readFileSync` before writing, so create a new chapter's `index.ts` before first generation. |
| Registry boot/cycle boundary | `main/src/story/beats/index.ts` is the registration side effect imported by `App.tsx`. `beats/registry.ts` provides `chapterReactivationBeat`. Modules consulting contracts must not import the side-effect index; contracts already import their dependencies. `storyState.chapterForBeat` reads generated metadata, not a handwritten mapping. |
| Gameplay director | `storyDirector.ts` calls `enterEmergentStoryBeat` and `emergentStoryDirectorTick` from `emergentStoryDirector.ts`. Add small dispatch connections there to a new chapter-local director; avoid putting all new mechanics in the already dirty 2,000+ line files. The emergent enter path clears guidance if nothing published and enters the signed AV beat; preserve those semantics. |
| Dormant entry | `StoryDirectorDriver.tsx` drives `tickChapter10FreePlayEntry` while the story is inactive. A new watch needs its own bounded call at this seam, using physical world/flight state and restored-hearth receipts. Do not rely on `advanceToBeat` from `done`: it leaves `active: false`. `reactivateStoryAtBeat` performs the live ownership transition. |
| Objectives | `storyObjectiveGuidance.ts` is now a generated-contract view. `beats/objectivePrimitives.ts` owns `StoryObjectiveGuidanceFacts`, defaults and normalization. Add a compact chapter fact shape and keep new prose/resolvers beside the chapter. `emergentStoryDirector.syncEmergentObjectiveGuidance` supplies live facts; a new dispatch must preserve its publication gate and entry bookkeeping. |
| Marker readiness | `beats/worldHandles.ts`, `storyWorldHandles.ts`, `beats/markerTargets.ts`: `registerStoryMarkerWorld` binds readiness; `resolveMarkerTarget` resolves the same candidate for publication and display. Extend a typed target/handle for the actual next physical target, without another marker overlay. `StoryDirectorDriver` already renders the directional marker. |
| F interaction | New IDs require `main/src/game/systems/interactionSystem.ts::InteractionId` and the exhaustive policy in `story/storyInteractions.ts`. Register one world-scoped resolver through `registerStoryInteraction`, retaining explicit priority/class/owner and cleanup. `EfficientPlayer.tsx` already resolves story actions before door/board/drink every frame, publishes the sole prompt and acts on the rising F edge. No new player key or player-loop edit is needed. Building owns F while build mode is active, so the design must disclose/handle that context. |
| Feedback | `ux/objectiveDirector.ts` is presentation only; objective IDs change when the next player action changes. `feedbackCues.ts`, `objectiveEventFeedback.ts`, `objectiveCommandFeedback.ts` handle semantic acknowledgement, cancellation and one-shot completion. New mechanic commits should provide typed confirmed events; seed/restore must not sound like a newly completed act. HUD and marker must clear within the contracted frames. |
| World mount | `main/src/story/world/StoryWorldProps.tsx` owns Origin story props, mounted-world anchors and W-7744's body. This is a cleaner seam than the dirty `EfficientScene.tsx`. Add a chapter-scoped world component here. `story/world/storyWorld.ts` is a facade over `storyAnchorResolver.ts`, `storyAnchorTypes.ts`, `storyWorldIdentity.ts` and prepared world-cache anchors; do not implement new procedural geometry in the facade. |

## Station ch11/ch12: preserve the existing route honestly

`game/spaceStation/spaceStationStory.ts` already owns station-local stages `registry | issuer | depart | complete`, `bootstrapStationStorySession`, `deriveStationStoryStep`, transaction commits and persistence. Its receipts include `story:ch11-docked`, designation/registry/fault receipts, `story:ch11-bonded-cell-acquired`, stowed and departed. It is a separate React entry after a hard page navigation, not an active story beat.

`story/stationReturnStory.ts` owns `stationReturnPending`, `stationReturnObjective`, `stationReturnMarkerTarget`, `installTidegardenBondedCell` and the durable `story:ch12-bonded-cell-installed` / `story:ch12-hearth-restored` receipts. Installation checks world, pending cargo, habitat and 4.2-unit reach, consumes one cell, and commits both receipts. `world/TidegardenSettlementWorld.tsx` registers its F action. The inactive-story branch of `StoryDirectorDriver.tsx` publishes this sidecar objective; `App.tsx` suppresses competing system route guidance while it owns the route.

`App.enterSpaceStation` deliberately strips `story`, `movie` and debug/probe flags before entering the station. Keeping a rehearsal beat URL would reseed and erase the completed save. `SpaceStationSandbox.onSequenceComplete` persists departure and returns with `undock`/`fly`; `spaceStationUndock.searchAfterUndockConsumed` removes those one-shot pose directives after reconstruction. Preserve this behavior.

### Registration choice

Formalizing the existing visit/return as ch11/ch12 is feasible, but is not a small JSON addition. Every formal beat presently requires an App-style contract, generated metadata, runtime order, objective projection, deep-link/seed/resume behavior and acceptance observations. Station-local objectives do not use the `GuidedStoryObjective` contract, and the station page has no live App story director. A truthful formalization therefore needs an explicit execution-host adapter (`station` versus `world/free-play`) so its formal beat views derive from the **existing** commits and stage functions. The adapter must handle direct entry/resume and the existing physical navigation, not recreate the transaction or call a fake `advanceToBeat` merely for evidence. This is a separate bounded integration packet if selected; preserve all existing receipt strings and keep exactly one owner of each action.

The smallest honest route for this chapter is an explicit, typed station/return transition contract, with ch11/ch12 identity retained in that contract. It connects ch10's existing threshold exit to the next formal chapter's restored-hearth entry, references the existing producers above, and is independently evidenced. Add schema/tool support and tests for that named external transition rather than weakening adjacency checks. Existing direct chapter-to-chapter checks remain unchanged; the transition itself must prove both of its boundaries and its committed receipts.

This is necessary because `main/tools/chapter-registry-gate.mjs::validateAdjacency` currently requires exact predecessor exit/next entry `stateRefs` equality and every next entry requirement in predecessor guarantees. Ch10's actual exit is station-targeted flight. It does not guarantee restored hearth, on-foot Origin or station departure. Do not add those false guarantees to ch10; do not omit the true new entry requirements to get a green gate. The new transition type must retain a strict composed chain with independently checked entry, exit, milestones and source references. The final choice belongs in the production lock, with source/schema/gate and journey coverage explicitly owned.

`main/story-authority.json` also pins runtime ceiling, order and evidence chain. Extend runtime authority only after the signed packet and delegated decision; preserve its release/demo ceiling. New checkpoint rows must match `STORY_MILESTONES` and the literal `storyEntryPoint` clauses because the registry gate parses those exact source declarations. Supported `state:` references in the registry gate are an explicit allowlist: add a runtime producer in `storyBoundaryTelemetry.ts` before adding a corresponding new pattern.

## Save data and reusable physical state

There is no single generic narrative-ledger store. `game/systems/observationLedger.ts` and `accomplishmentLedger.ts` each expose schema version 1, typed reducers, logical sequence ordering, idempotent evidence IDs, serialize/hydrate functions, actor scope and subscriptions. `ledgerEvidence.ts` supplies JSON-safe evidence payloads. `persistence.GlobalSave` already saves/restores both as optional fields, keeping pre-ledger saves readable.

Observations explicitly **must never be story prerequisites**. Use them for noticed evidence, comparisons, doubts and interpretation variants. Accomplishments can record actual committed acts; neither ledger should become a hidden approval switch based on player interpretation. `emergentStoryEvents.ts` is a typed, deduplicated **session** event stream, not persistent storage. New semantic events can be added here or behind a chapter-local typed publisher; do not rely on its in-memory history for resume.

Keep immutable chapter checkpoints as named `story:` milestones. Reusable/reversible stake placement and a worker's current traversal state cannot be represented safely by a growing pile of untyped `placed:N:x:y` milestones. If placement must survive save/reload, use one chapter-local versioned snapshot with bounded slots, world/actor identity, validated numeric poses and explicit retry/hold state. The existing per-world `WorldSave.habitat` pattern is the nearby precedent: add an optional field and explicit save/restore/clear functions in `persistence.ts`, with the new world component resetting/restoring through that boundary. Do not reset somebody else's world state during ordinary entry. If the signed contract intentionally makes uncommitted placements ephemeral, document and test reconstruction instead; the survey does not choose that creative behavior.

Test absent/legacy snapshots, malformed placement data, wrong world/actor, identical event replay, partial retry, completed chapter reload, quit/Continue, explicit restart and deep-link seeding. `restartStory` currently removes story milestones and resets two authored worlds; it does not clear every narrative ledger record. A new chapter must explicitly define its restart behavior instead of assuming those evidence stores were erased. New deep links need the **physical** restored-hearth and Origin prerequisites, including world/ship/camera pose; adding preceding milestones alone is insufficient. Keep `?keep=1` and normal menu Continue paths non-destructive.

## W-7744 and terrain navigation

`AuditWorker.tsx` renders the module pose returned by `getAuditWorkerPose` and publishes `actor:w7744` journey state. It is not a controller or physics body. It already precompiles materials and uses an emissive visor without adding a dynamic light. Reuse it; do not duplicate the body or add a global light/renderer.

`auditWorkerPresence.shouldMountAuditWorker` currently allows only Origin + ch4 + not-departed. `StoryWorldProps` derives the old departure latch from `FIELD_PACK_DROPPED_MILESTONE` and calls `hideAuditWorker` when unmounted. A returning instance needs a new explicit chapter-presence branch independent of that old latch, while preserving A4's pack/absence proof. `A4WorldChoreography` writes the body only during `a4-exhale`; the new director must be the only writer during the new chapter. Publish mounted/visible/hidden/absent states through existing journey telemetry on entry, leave, retry, reload and completion.

`emergentStoryDirector.moveAuditor` is private but demonstrates the reusable lower-level seam: `utils/agentSurfaceNavigationRuntime.ts::createLiveAgentSurfaceTerrain`, `agentSurfaceNavigation.ts::planAgentSurfaceRoute`, and `groundedSurfaceMotion.ts::groundedSurfaceRouteLength`, `sampleGroundedSurfaceRoute`, `turnGroundedHeadingToward`. Current audit walking plans a dry top-face route, forbids cross-face/jetpack fallback, bounds clearance/slope/visited cells and replans on terrain revision. New chapter-local movement can reuse these utilities directly without extracting/altering existing audit behavior. An unreachable route must hold/refuse with observable reason; it cannot teleport or claim success from an elapsed timer.

Use the mounted anchors for existing pond, tree, wreck and terrain. Fixed authored placement candidates can be derived chapter-locally from those anchors and live terrain validation; do not change prepared anchor generation, terrain seeds or procedural world generation merely to add this mechanic. If arbitrary placement is approved, its traversability checks and finite-state consequences need meaningful tests beyond the rendering component.

## Movie and audiovisual integration

`story/autopilot.ts` now only re-exports `autopilot/primitives.ts`. The latter owns `autopilotTick`, `RailRuntime`, movement/gaze/action helpers, reset and stuck handling. `autopilot/rails.ts::BEAT_RAILS` derives ticks from beat definitions. Add chapter-local `rail-<beat>.ts` modules that move/look/use the same registered interaction commits as the player. `beats/railDiscipline.test.ts` rejects grant/seed/advance/nudge calls and currently pins a 29-file census; update the census honestly when adding rails.

The existing movie has two `done` bridges: reach the hearth/night gate for ch10, then approach and dock after ch10. `movieStationBridgeActive` currently remains eligible whenever ch10 is complete and docking authorized. On station entry `stationmovie=1` carries movie intent separately from rehearsal parameters. `StationScreeningDriver.tsx` walks and clicks actual station UI; it currently ends after the cell is acquired and a look-around dwell. It does **not** depart or fly home. A continuous new-chapter movie therefore needs: bounded station departure through the real airlock action; transfer of screening intent to the return page without `story=<beat>` reseeding; flight/landing/installation using real shipped actions; then the real new-chapter entry watch. Stop the old dock bridge once departure/return supersedes it. Keep each phase bounded and report a stuck result; a seeded direct chapter preview is not proof of this chain.

`storyScore.ts` still owns actual beat moods/variants/hit declarations and score APIs; this ownership has not moved into `BeatContract`. Add the director-authored chapter mood/variant data as a new local module and connect through existing score APIs, rather than editing `src/audio/` instruments. Durable story facts should reselect score state on reload without replaying completion hits. `emergentScoreDirector.ts` demonstrates this for chapter 10.

`tools/generate-scene-av-runtime.mjs::SIGNED_SOURCES` pins exact contracts, hashes, versions and anchor counts. The runtime mirror is `signedSceneAvRuntime.ts::SIGNED_SCENE_AV_SOURCES`, source constants and anchor census; generated output is `generatedSceneAvRuntime.json`. Register the new signed scene in both source inventories and `chapter-registry.json.sceneContracts`, then generate/check. `activateSignedSceneSemanticEvent` and `activateSignedSceneAnchorById` let a commit publish a signed semantic moment; `enterSignedSceneAvBeat`/`tickSignedSceneAvRuntime` retain beat, reset, pause and one-shot ownership. No new global postprocessing/audio engine is implied.

## Small implementation surface and collision control

Suggested new modules, names provisional until the signed packet: `story/commonGroundState.ts`, `story/commonGroundDirector.ts`, `story/commonGroundScore.ts`, `story/world/CommonGroundWorld.tsx`, plus `story/beats/ch13/<beat>.ts`, objective resolver, rails and focused tests. Use a separate navigation helper only if the mechanic exceeds a small function; use the existing surface utilities.

# Story Intent — Common Ground

Author: Chapter Director  
Status: **derived Stage 1 draft; bounded arena decision reopened by pass-2 evidence; runtime remains closed**  
Contract target: Common Ground, run `2026-09-05-after-the-hearth`; exact scene revision/layout unsigned.

## Grounding

This translates the signed council direction into production requirements. It is not another treatment, canon decision, dispatch or signature. Governing council directory: `../../story-runs/2026-09-06-common-ground/`.

- `story-authority-candidate.md` SHA-256: `790b2894a48d6eb2a24816dede8ff8d911448e217e18f394d25be35444cd87ae`.
- `canon-decision-register.json` SHA-256: `017bafdae9b1e7148c5f037b3e79ac44fc850aaa2a26e4ca1f303bd6346690fd`.
- Exact three-director signatures, `owner-story-decision.json`, `director-notes.json`, and accepted `chapter-reconciliation.json` supply the reconciled authority. The producer exercised standing user delegation, not personal owner review of future hashes/media.
- Current addenda read: `main/PARAVOXIA_STORY_BIBLE.md:15`, `main/PARAVOXIA_STORY_EXECUTION_PLAN.md:44`, `main/STORY.md:3`. Formal runtime ends ch10; R12 station/return is implemented separately; ch13 is approved direction; public release remains `ch4-arrival`.
- `integration-survey.md` supplies runtime owners and exact future boundary references. Preserve live untracked beat/autopilot refactors and unrelated dirty work.

**Pass 2 reopens the bounded arena decision.** Read `geometry-pass2.md/json` alongside retained pass 1. Correct rendered-cube gating and voxel-AABB rays show that pass 1's apparent terrain relief/occlusion came from logical voxels outside the rendered world. All 1,193 walkable corridor nodes are at the same support height. The corrected CPU search finds a 68-unit/96-sample reference-clear route and a 64-unit/92-sample occluded route. Their distinction is four walking units and, in the primary solution, two samples hidden by the 1.1-unit trunk. 981 positions satisfy the proposed witness test, including the start. This is mathematically distinct but does not establish the meaningful physical choice or reciprocal need promised by the intent. **Do not freeze this arena as production-ready.**

Pass 2 also finds that the existing voxel route planner does not know the real trunk collider and can plan through it. Its reported routes apply an explicit trunk guard. Any later scene route must respect actual solid trunk geometry as well as terrain; report and scope that correction through the chapter-local route-validation seam, not a global worldgen or unreviewed navigation rewrite.

The 128-sample and 120-unit caps remain simultaneous limits. Both measured paths fit, so no cap change is warranted. Source-derived socket candidates are now known (worker visor 1.85, chest 1.30, hand 1.25; player eye 1.35 units above grounded pose), but no arena/socket assignment is signed. Correct rays, real solid occluders and candidate sockets are measurement inputs, not permission to preserve a trivial encounter by adding restrictions. The next bounded director refinement must make route choice and reciprocal usefulness meaningful while preserving reversible walked trace, actual world relations and no global worldgen change. Existing frames, live edits, night and interaction behavior remain unverified.

No day/night, hardware, mobile, low-tier, motion, audio or continuous-story acceptance is claimed. The planning-only lock and initial status/hash artifacts remain unchanged. Council judgment and the separate scene contract must pass before runtime opens.

## Dramatic contract

- **Player action:** choose Origin from a working home; walk and offer a trace; inspect a specific hold; revise the untested tail or hold an intermediate reference; use W-7744's reference for a reciprocal crossing; leave room for his independent test.
- **Before → after:** a shared view seemed necessary → one reliable act can preserve different accounts.
- **Information:** W-7744 repeats his unresolved local measurement and retains `LOCAL RECORD: PASSAGE OBSERVED. MODEL INCOMPLETE.`
- **Ambiguity:** his interiority, larger allegiance and later awakening remain unknown. Local usefulness is not friendship.

# Common Ground — implementation interface plan (ch13)

Preparation only, 2026-09-06. No runtime/main source edit, no build, test, probe or signature was performed. Symbols below were read from the live worktree (including untracked `beats/` and `autopilot/`), not from the older survey. Geometry numbers (selected instrument range, socket assignment, arena coordinates, exact sample/route layout) are **deferred input** from the signed scene contract; nothing here selects them. This plan assumes the accepted direction only and proposes no creative content.

## 0. Rules for the one integration engineer

Namespaced chapter-local modules; each shared file receives a **single small call**, no refactor of `storyState.ts`, `emergentStoryDirector.ts`, `storyDirector.ts`, `App.tsx`, `EfficientScene.tsx`, `EfficientPlayer.tsx`. All of those are dirty; re-check `ls -l` immediately before edit and never reset/stash. Score uses the existing `storyScore.ts` facade only — no engine graph, no new instrument, no bundle.

## 1. New chapter-local files (all new; no existing file moves)

| File | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundState.ts` | Versioned bounded trace state + reducers + serialize/hydrate/migrate/reset. Pure, no React, no world imports. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundRoute.ts` | Prop/solid-aware grounded route validation and the walked-prefix predicate. Pure over injected terrain/solid queries. |

# Common Ground — implementation interface plan (ch13)

Preparation only, 2026-09-06. No runtime/main source edit, no build, test, probe or signature was performed. Symbols below were read from the live worktree (including untracked `beats/` and `autopilot/`), not from the older survey. Geometry numbers (selected instrument range, socket assignment, arena coordinates, exact sample/route layout) are **deferred input** from the signed scene contract; nothing here selects them. This plan assumes the accepted direction only and proposes no creative content.

## 0. Rules for the one integration engineer

Namespaced chapter-local modules; each shared file receives a **single small call**, no refactor of `storyState.ts`, `emergentStoryDirector.ts`, `storyDirector.ts`, `App.tsx`, `EfficientScene.tsx`, `EfficientPlayer.tsx`. All of those are dirty; re-check `ls -l` immediately before edit and never reset/stash. Score uses the existing `storyScore.ts` facade only — no engine graph, no new instrument, no bundle.

## 1. New chapter-local files (all new; no existing file moves)

| File | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundState.ts` | Versioned bounded trace state + reducers + serialize/hydrate/migrate/reset. Pure, no React, no world imports. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundRoute.ts` | Prop/solid-aware grounded route validation and the walked-prefix predicate. Pure over injected terrain/solid queries. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundDirector.ts` | Live tick/enter dispatch, objective facts, commit events, marker target, interaction resolver registration. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundScore.ts` | ch13 mood/variant table + the live-only coda allowance, expressed through `storyScore` APIs. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundActor.ts` | The single ch13 writer of W-7744's pose + presence branch. |
| `main/src/story/world/CommonGroundWorld.tsx` | Chapter-scoped world component: trace render, fixed plate, world handles registration, save restore/clear boundary. |
| `main/src/story/beats/ch13/{ch13-home,ch13-return,ch13-survey,ch13-common}.ts` | Four `defineBeat` contracts; filename === beat id. |
| `main/src/story/beats/ch13/{index.ts,definitions.ts}` | **`index.ts` must exist before the first generator run** (`emit` reads before write). |
| `main/src/story/autopilot/rail-ch13-*.ts` | Rails; move/look/act only. |
| `*.test.ts` beside each | See §8. |

## 2. Finite bounded trace state — `commonGroundState.ts`

Exported surface (proposed, exact):

```ts
export const COMMON_GROUND_SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 1;
export interface TraceSample { x: number; y: number; z: number; corner: boolean }
export interface TraceSlot {
  id: 'accepted' | 'working';
  samples: readonly TraceSample[];      // <= MAX_SAMPLES
  lengthUnits: number;                   // <= MAX_TRACE_UNITS
  testedPrefixCount: number;             // samples proven by an actual test
  tailRevision: number;                  // monotonic; bumps only on tail edit
  offeredEndIndex: number | null;
}
export interface CommonGroundSnapshot {
  version: typeof COMMON_GROUND_SNAPSHOT_VERSION;
  actorId: string; worldId: string;
  slots: Readonly<Record<'accepted' | 'working', TraceSlot | null>>;
  witness: { index: number; offered: boolean } | null;   // at most one active
  reciprocal: { held: boolean } | null;
  hold: { reason: 'out-of-range' | 'unsupported' | 'occluded' | null };
  safePose: TraceSample | null;
}
export function createEmptySnapshot(actorId: string, worldId: string): CommonGroundSnapshot;
export function appendSample(s, sample): CommonGroundSnapshot;         // honest stop at capacity
export function reviseTail(s, fromIndex): CommonGroundSnapshot;         // preserves testedPrefixCount, bumps tailRevision
export function invalidateTestedPrefix(s, fromIndex): CommonGroundSnapshot; // only for real voxel/support change
export function clearUncommitted(s): CommonGroundSnapshot;              // explicit proposal reset only
export function serializeCommonGround(s): unknown;
export function hydrateCommonGround(raw: unknown, actorId, worldId): CommonGroundSnapshot | null; // null on version/actor/world mismatch
export function migrateCommonGround(raw: unknown): unknown | null;      // absent/legacy -> null, never throw
```

Invariants the tests must pin: capacity stop never decimates a recorded corner; `testedPrefixCount` is never reduced by `reviseTail`; hydration of a wrong `actorId`/`worldId` returns `null` (not a partial graft); `clearUncommitted` never touches the `accepted` slot; pause / failed input / Continue never call it.

**Numeric constants (`MAX_SAMPLES`, `MAX_TRACE_UNITS`, spacing, corner threshold, witness radii/tolerances, selected instrument range, socket heights) are declared as named exports with no committed values in this plan.** They are contract-supplied.

## 3. Persistence seam — `main/src/game/systems/persistence.ts`

Precedent to copy exactly is `WorldSave.habitat` (`persistence.ts:239`, snapshot at `:253`, restore at `:301`). Minimal change:

- add `commonGround?: unknown` to the `WorldSave` interface;
- write it in `saveWorld` beside `habitat`, guarded by `worldId`;
- add `restoreCommonGroundForWorld(world: WorldSaveRef)` and `clearCommonGroundForWorld(world: WorldSaveRef)` alongside `restoreHabitatForWorld` / `clearCampfiresForWorld`;
- `clearWorldStateForWorld` clears it for **that world only**.

No `GlobalSave` change. Ledgers (`observationLedger`, `accomplishmentLedger`) are optional evidence only and must not gate progression. `restartStory()` (`storyState.ts:775`) must be given an explicit ch13 clear call; it does not clear ledgers today.

## 4. Actor: single pose writer, prop-aware grounded route

- `AuditWorker.tsx` renders `getAuditWorkerPose()`; keep it as the only body. `commonGroundActor.ts` becomes the sole writer while a ch13 beat is active (`A4WorldChoreography` writes only during `a4-exhale`; do not overlap).
- `auditWorkerPresence.ts::shouldMountAuditWorker` (single export, `:11`) needs one extra explicit ch13 branch, independent of `FIELD_PACK_DROPPED_MILESTONE`. A4's pack/absence proof must stay green.
- Routing reuses, unmodified: `utils/agentSurfaceNavigationRuntime.ts::createLiveAgentSurfaceTerrain` (`:13`), `utils/agentSurfaceNavigation.ts::planAgentSurfaceRoute` (`:305`, with `AgentSurfaceRouteOptions` / `AgentSurfaceRouteReason` / `AgentSurfaceRoute`), and `utils/groundedSurfaceMotion.ts::{groundedSurfaceRouteLength, sampleGroundedSurfaceRoute, turnGroundedHeadingToward}`.
- **Known gap (pass-2 finding):** the voxel planner does not know the real trunk collider and can plan through it. The correction belongs in `commonGroundRoute.ts` as a solid-occluder guard layered over `planAgentSurfaceRoute`, not in the shared navigation module and not in worldgen. Unreachable/unsupported/out-of-range must return distinct typed reasons and produce a hold at the last safe sample — never a teleport or a timer-derived success.

## 5. Dormant reactivation and live dispatch (four one-line seams)

1. `StoryDirectorDriver.tsx` — beside the existing `!story.active` branch that calls `tickChapter10FreePlayEntry` (`:181`) and publishes `stationReturnObjective` (`:146`), add one bounded `tickCommonGroundEntry(...)` call. It must call `reactivateStoryAtBeat('ch13-home')` (`storyState.ts:821`), never `advanceToBeat` (`:808`, leaves `active:false`).
2. `emergentStoryDirector.ts` — `enterEmergentStoryBeat` (`:645`) and `emergentStoryDirectorTick` (`:787`) each get one ch13 dispatch line preserving the existing guidance-clear + signed-AV-enter semantics and the publication gate in `syncEmergentObjectiveGuidance`.
3. `storyState.ts` — `storyEntryPoint()` (`:246`) gains ch13 resume clauses **before** the `ch10Complete` clause and must return `alive` reality explicitly (else falls through to `bare`); `STORY_BEAT_ORDER` (`:333`) gains the four ids before `done`; `StoryChapter`/`StoryBeat` unions and `STORY_MILESTONES` (`:120`) gain ch13 rows. Keep `done` last.
4. `beats/index.ts` — add the `ch13` import (the generator does not add it).

Objective facts extend `beats/objectivePrimitives.ts::StoryObjectiveGuidanceFacts` (`:84`) with a compact ch13 fact block plus defaults in `DEFAULT_STORY_OBJECTIVE_GUIDANCE_FACTS` (`:116`); ch13 objective prose/resolvers live in `beats/ch13/`, not in `objectivePrimitives.ts`.

Marker: extend `beats/worldHandles.ts::WorldMarkerHandle` (`:9`) with the ch13 targets and resolve through `beats/markerTargets.ts::resolveMarkerTarget` (`:20`); `registerStoryMarkerWorld` (`:10`) is called from `CommonGroundWorld.tsx`. One marker authority; no new overlay.

Interaction: add ids to `game/systems/interactionSystem.ts::InteractionId` (`:9`, must match `story-${string}` for `StoryInteractionId`), extend the exhaustive policy in `story/storyInteractions.ts`, and register one world-scoped resolver via `registerStoryInteraction` (`:287`) with explicit priority/class/owner and cleanup. No player-loop or key change; build mode keeps F.

## 6. Registered ch13 beats and the strict EXTERNAL boundary

Four contracts via `beats/beatContract.ts::defineBeat` (`:73`); `entry: 'reactivation-from-done'` for `ch13-home`, `'sequence'` for the rest; every `rail` declares `stuckAfterSeconds` and `waitReason` and may not grant/mark/advance.

`chapter-registry.json` (`main/chapter-registry.json`, keys `schema | runtimeAuthorityRef | terminalBeat | sceneContracts | chapters`) gets a `ch13` record with `order: 11` (array position, not chapter number), `beats`, `before: ['ch10']`, `entry`, `exit`, `checkpoints`, `objectiveRefs`, `revealRefs`, and a new `sceneContracts` entry.

`tools/chapter-registry-gate.mjs::validateAdjacency` requires exact predecessor-exit / next-entry `stateRefs` equality. Ch10's real exit is `state:control/flight` + `state:space-station/{targeted}` + `state:station/docking-authorized`; ch13's real entry is restored hearth, on-foot Origin, station departed. **Do not add false guarantees to ch10 and do not drop true ch13 entry requirements.** Add a named `externalTransitions` entry type to the registry + its schema + the gate, of the shape:

```
{ id: 'ch10->ch13-via-station', from: {chapter:'ch10', exitBeat:'ch10-transit'},
  to: {chapter:'ch13', entryBeat:'ch13-home'},
  hostSegments: ['station(ch11)', 'return(ch12)'],
  producedReceipts: ['story:ch11-docked','story:ch11-bonded-cell-acquired',
                     'story:ch12-bonded-cell-installed','story:ch12-hearth-restored'],
  entryGuarantees: [...], evidenceRefs: [...] }
```

Ordinary chapter-to-chapter adjacency checks stay strict and unchanged; the transition proves both boundaries independently. Receipt strings stay byte-identical — they are owned by `game/spaceStation/spaceStationStory.ts::STATION_STORY_MILESTONES` (`:29`, with `bootstrapStationStorySession :108`, `deriveStationStoryStep :134`, `commitStationDeparted :201`, `issueBondedCell :179`) and `story/stationReturnStory.ts::STATION_RETURN_MILESTONES` (`:16`, with `installTidegardenBondedCell :109`, `stationReturnPending :39`, `stationReturnObjective :56`, `stationReturnMarkerTarget :85`, `STATION_RETURN_INSTALL_REACH :137`). Do not reimplement either transaction.

New `state:` refs need a producer in `story/storyBoundaryTelemetry.ts` (`deriveStoryBoundaryState :120`, `readStoryBoundaryRuntime :208`, `publishStoryBoundaryTelemetry :264`) **before** the gate allowlist `SUPPORTED_STATE_REF_PATTERNS` (`chapter-registry-gate.mjs:27`) gains a pattern. `main/story-authority.json` (`runtimeBeatOrder`, `runtimeEvidenceChain`, `activeProduction`, `openReleaseGates`) and `chapter-journey-contract.json` are updated only after signature; the demo ceiling at `ch4-arrival` is untouched.

Generator order: create `beats/ch13/index.ts` → `npm run chapter:registry:generate` → hand-add the `ch13` registry record and the `beats/index.ts` import → `chapter:registry:check`, `chapter:journey:check`.

## 7. Rail seams: station movie → depart → flight → Tidegarden → install → next chapter

Pinned current behavior: `App.enterSpaceStation` strips `story`, `movie` and debug flags before the hard navigation — **a rehearsal `story=<beat>` must never be reintroduced or the completed save is reseeded**. `SpaceStationSandbox.onSequenceComplete` persists departure and returns with `undock`/`fly`; `spaceStationUndock.ts::{parseUndockFlag :22, requestedUndockAddress :39, searchAfterUndockConsumed :49, undockedShipPose :66}` consumes those one-shot directives. `StationScreeningDriver.tsx` currently ends after cell acquisition + dwell.

Required seam work, all bounded, each reporting `stuck` rather than rescuing:
`stationmovie=1` → real airlock/depart action → screening-intent carry-over on the return URL **without** `story=` → `undock`/`fly` reconstruction → flight/landing rail → real `installTidegardenBondedCell` F action in `world/TidegardenSettlementWorld.tsx` → invitation choice at the certified-home core → ch13 entry watch. Then retire the old dock bridge: `autopilot/primitives.ts::isMovieStationBridgeActive` (`:1732`) currently stays eligible whenever ch10 is complete; it must yield once departure/return supersedes it. Rails derive from `autopilot/rails.ts::BEAT_RAILS` (`:5`); `beats/railDiscipline.test.ts` pins a 29-file census — update it honestly.

## 8. Score and signed AV

`commonGroundScore.ts` calls only the existing facade: `storyScore.ts::{setScoreBeat :1017, getStoryScoreMood :972, setStoryScoreMoodOverride :993, unlockStoryScore :967, resetStoryScoreRuntime :1032, setScoreIntensity/scoreHit (re-export :965)}`, plus `MOOD_TONIC_CHAINS :594` / `TONIC_CHAIN_POLICY :606` rows. Follow `emergentScoreDirector.ts` as the pattern for reselect-on-reload without replaying hits. The ≤5 s live-only coda is the one required new behavior: today deactivation clears score immediately, so ch13 needs an explicit chapter-local presentation hold that hands to the existing 4.5 s release fade, cancels on every signed trigger, and never defers/hydrates/replays. No new hit anchor in `STORY_HIT_ANCHORS` (`:538`); no engine graph.

Signed AV registration is two mirrored inventories plus one JSON: `tools/generate-scene-av-runtime.mjs::SIGNED_SOURCES` and `story/signedSceneAvRuntime.ts::SIGNED_SCENE_AV_SOURCES` (`:49`, with per-scene sha/revision constants and the anchor census), then `npm run scene:av:generate` / `scene:av:check` regenerating `generatedSceneAvRuntime.json`. Commits publish moments through `activateSignedSceneSemanticEvent` (`:850`) / `activateSignedSceneAnchorById` (`:844`); `enterSignedSceneAvBeat` (`:785`), `tickSignedSceneAvRuntime` (`:855`) and `resetSignedSceneAvRuntime` (`:903`) retain beat/pause/reset ownership.

## 9. Behavioral test holes (new) and existing anchors to extend

New: `commonGroundState.test.ts` (capacity, corner preservation, tested-prefix/tail-revision, wrong actor/world, absent/legacy/malformed hydration, clear scope), `commonGroundRoute.test.ts` (trunk-solid guard, unsupported vs out-of-range vs occluded reasons, hold-at-last-safe, replan on terrain revision), `commonGroundDirector.test.ts` (one semantic acknowledgement per objective entry, marker/work-order parity, idempotent commit, reciprocal precondition), `commonGroundScore.test.ts` (coda cancellation matrix, no replay on hydrate).
Extend: `beats/allContracts.test.ts`, `beatRegistry.test.ts`, `railDiscipline.test.ts`, `screeningParity.test.ts`, `auditWorkerPresence.test.ts`, `storyInteractions.test.ts`, `storyState.test.ts`, `persistence.test.ts`, `stationReturnStory.test.ts`, `spaceStationStory.test.ts`, `spaceStationUndock.test.ts`, `storyBoundaryTelemetry.test.ts`, `agentSurfaceNavigation*.test.ts`, `groundedSurfaceMotion.test.ts`.

## 10. Remaining dependencies before an engineer can start

1. Selected instrument range (12 vs 24) and socket assignment — three-lane reconciliation, unsigned.
2. Arena coordinates and the two route classes' proof that they meet the ≥12-unit / ≥25% / ≥6-unit-unsupported floor — pass-2 says the current arena does **not**; do not freeze it.
3. Trace caps, spacing, corner threshold, witness radii/tolerances as contract constants.
4. Exact objective ids, marker labels, work-order copy, feedback ids (Chapter's four `guidanceReplacements` supersede earlier wording).
5. The chosen external-transition schema shape signed into the registry schema + gate.
6. Signed scene contract sha/revision for the AV inventories and the registry `sceneContracts` entry.
7. Owner-delegated decision recorded after the three signatures; production lock moved off `planning-only`.

| `main/src/story/commonGroundActor.ts` | The single ch13 writer of W-7744's pose + presence branch. |
| `main/src/story/world/CommonGroundWorld.tsx` | Chapter-scoped world component: trace render, fixed plate, world handles registration, save restore/clear boundary. |
| `main/src/story/beats/ch13/{ch13-home,ch13-return,ch13-survey,ch13-common}.ts` | Four `defineBeat` contracts; filename === beat id. |
| `main/src/story/beats/ch13/{index.ts,definitions.ts}` | **`index.ts` must exist before the first generator run** (`emit` reads before write). |
| `main/src/story/autopilot/rail-ch13-*.ts` | Rails; move/look/act only. |
| `*.test.ts` beside each | See §8. |

## 2. Finite bounded trace state — `commonGroundState.ts`

Exported surface (proposed, exact):

```ts
export const COMMON_GROUND_SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 1;
export interface TraceSample { x: number; y: number; z: number; corner: boolean }
export interface TraceSlot {
  id: 'accepted' | 'working';
  samples: readonly TraceSample[];  // <= MAX_SAMPLES
  lengthUnits: number;              // <= MAX_TRACE_UNITS
  testedPrefixCount: number;        // samples proven by an actual test
  tailRevision: number;             // monotonic; bumps only on tail edit
  offeredEndIndex: number | null;
}
export interface CommonGroundSnapshot {
  version: typeof COMMON_GROUND_SNAPSHOT_VERSION;
  actorId: string; worldId: string;
  slots: Readonly<Record<'accepted' | 'working', TraceSlot | null>>;
  witness: { index: number; offered: boolean } | null;   // at most one
  reciprocal: { held: boolean } | null;
  hold: { reason: 'out-of-range' | 'unsupported' | 'occluded' | null };
  safePose: TraceSample | null;
}
createEmptySnapshot(actorId, worldId)
appendSample(s, sample)          // honest stop at capacity
reviseTail(s, fromIndex)         // preserves testedPrefixCount, bumps tailRevision
invalidateTestedPrefix(s, from)  // only on real voxel/support change
clearUncommitted(s)              // explicit proposal reset only
serializeCommonGround(s) / hydrateCommonGround(raw, actorId, worldId)
migrateCommonGround(raw)         // absent/legacy -> null, never throws
```

Invariants tests must pin: capacity stop never decimates a recorded corner; `reviseTail` never lowers `testedPrefixCount`; wrong `actorId`/`worldId` hydrates to `null`, not a partial graft; `clearUncommitted` never touches `accepted`; pause / failed input / Continue never call it.

**Numeric constants (`MAX_SAMPLES`, `MAX_TRACE_UNITS`, spacing, corner threshold, witness radii/tolerances, selected instrument range, socket heights) are declared as named exports with no committed values in this plan.** They are contract-supplied.

## 3. Persistence seam — `main/src/game/systems/persistence.ts`

Precedent to copy exactly is `WorldSave.habitat` (`persistence.ts:239`, snapshot at `:253`, restore at `:301`). Minimal change:

- add `commonGround?: unknown` to the `WorldSave` interface;
- write it in `saveWorld` beside `habitat`, guarded by `worldId`;
- add `restoreCommonGroundForWorld(world: WorldSaveRef)` and `clearCommonGroundForWorld(world: WorldSaveRef)` alongside `restoreHabitatForWorld` / `clearCampfiresForWorld`;
- `clearWorldStateForWorld` clears it for **that world only**.

No `GlobalSave` change. Ledgers (`observationLedger`, `accomplishmentLedger`) are optional evidence only and must not gate progression. `restartStory()` (`storyState.ts:775`) must be given an explicit ch13 clear call; it does not clear ledgers today.

## 4. Actor: single pose writer, prop-aware grounded route

- `AuditWorker.tsx` renders `getAuditWorkerPose()`; keep it as the only body. `commonGroundActor.ts` becomes the sole writer while a ch13 beat is active (`A4WorldChoreography` writes only during `a4-exhale`; do not overlap).
- `auditWorkerPresence.ts::shouldMountAuditWorker` (single export, `:11`) needs one extra explicit ch13 branch, independent of `FIELD_PACK_DROPPED_MILESTONE`. A4's pack/absence proof must stay green.
- Routing reuses, unmodified: `utils/agentSurfaceNavigationRuntime.ts::createLiveAgentSurfaceTerrain` (`:13`), `utils/agentSurfaceNavigation.ts::planAgentSurfaceRoute` (`:305`, with `AgentSurfaceRouteOptions` / `AgentSurfaceRouteReason` / `AgentSurfaceRoute`), and `utils/groundedSurfaceMotion.ts::{groundedSurfaceRouteLength, sampleGroundedSurfaceRoute, turnGroundedHeadingToward}`.
- **Known gap (pass-2 finding):** the voxel planner does not know the real trunk collider and can plan through it. The correction belongs in `commonGroundRoute.ts` as a solid-occluder guard layered over `planAgentSurfaceRoute`, not in the shared navigation module and not in worldgen. Unreachable/unsupported/out-of-range must return distinct typed reasons and produce a hold at the last safe sample — never a teleport or a timer-derived success.

## 5. Dormant reactivation and live dispatch (four one-line seams)

1. `StoryDirectorDriver.tsx` — beside the existing `!story.active` branch that calls `tickChapter10FreePlayEntry` (`:181`) and publishes `stationReturnObjective` (`:146`), add one bounded `tickCommonGroundEntry(...)` call. It must call `reactivateStoryAtBeat('ch13-home')` (`storyState.ts:821`), never `advanceToBeat` (`:808`, leaves `active:false`).
2. `emergentStoryDirector.ts` — `enterEmergentStoryBeat` (`:645`) and `emergentStoryDirectorTick` (`:787`) each get one ch13 dispatch line preserving the existing guidance-clear + signed-AV-enter semantics and the publication gate in `syncEmergentObjectiveGuidance`.
3. `storyState.ts` — `storyEntryPoint()` (`:246`) gains ch13 resume clauses **before** the `ch10Complete` clause and must return `alive` reality explicitly (else falls through to `bare`); `STORY_BEAT_ORDER` (`:333`) gains the four ids before `done`; `StoryChapter`/`StoryBeat` unions and `STORY_MILESTONES` (`:120`) gain ch13 rows. Keep `done` last.
4. `beats/index.ts` — add the `ch13` import (the generator does not add it).

Objective facts extend `beats/objectivePrimitives.ts::StoryObjectiveGuidanceFacts` (`:84`) with a compact ch13 fact block plus defaults in `DEFAULT_STORY_OBJECTIVE_GUIDANCE_FACTS` (`:116`); ch13 objective prose/resolvers live in `beats/ch13/`, not in `objectivePrimitives.ts`.

Marker: extend `beats/worldHandles.ts::WorldMarkerHandle` (`:9`) with the ch13 targets and resolve through `beats/markerTargets.ts::resolveMarkerTarget` (`:20`); `registerStoryMarkerWorld` (`:10`) is called from `CommonGroundWorld.tsx`. One marker authority; no new overlay.

Interaction: add ids to `game/systems/interactionSystem.ts::InteractionId` (`:9`, must match `story-${string}` for `StoryInteractionId`), extend the exhaustive policy in `story/storyInteractions.ts`, and register one world-scoped resolver via `registerStoryInteraction` (`:287`) with explicit priority/class/owner and cleanup. No player-loop or key change; build mode keeps F.

## 6. Registered ch13 beats and the strict EXTERNAL boundary

Four contracts via `beats/beatContract.ts::defineBeat` (`:73`); `entry: 'reactivation-from-done'` for `ch13-home`, `'sequence'` for the rest; every `rail` declares `stuckAfterSeconds` and `waitReason` and may not grant/mark/advance.

`chapter-registry.json` (`main/chapter-registry.json`, keys `schema | runtimeAuthorityRef | terminalBeat | sceneContracts | chapters`) gets a `ch13` record with `order: 11` (array position, not chapter number), `beats`, `before: ['ch10']`, `entry`, `exit`, `checkpoints`, `objectiveRefs`, `revealRefs`, and a new `sceneContracts` entry.

`tools/chapter-registry-gate.mjs::validateAdjacency` requires exact predecessor-exit / next-entry `stateRefs` equality. Ch10's real exit is `state:control/flight` + `state:space-station/{targeted}` + `state:station/docking-authorized`; ch13's real entry is restored hearth, on-foot Origin, station departed. **Do not add false guarantees to ch10 and do not drop true ch13 entry requirements.** Add a named `externalTransitions` entry type to the registry + its schema + the gate, of the shape:

```
{ id: 'ch10->ch13-via-station', from: {chapter:'ch10', exitBeat:'ch10-transit'},
  to: {chapter:'ch13', entryBeat:'ch13-home'},
  hostSegments: ['station(ch11)', 'return(ch12)'],
  producedReceipts: ['story:ch11-docked','story:ch11-bonded-cell-acquired',
                     'story:ch12-bonded-cell-installed','story:ch12-hearth-restored'],
  entryGuarantees: [...], evidenceRefs: [...] }
```

Ordinary chapter-to-chapter adjacency checks stay strict and unchanged; the transition proves both boundaries independently. Receipt strings stay byte-identical — they are owned by `game/spaceStation/spaceStationStory.ts::STATION_STORY_MILESTONES` (`:29`, with `bootstrapStationStorySession :108`, `deriveStationStoryStep :134`, `commitStationDeparted :201`, `issueBondedCell :179`) and `story/stationReturnStory.ts::STATION_RETURN_MILESTONES` (`:16`, with `installTidegardenBondedCell :109`, `stationReturnPending :39`, `stationReturnObjective :56`, `stationReturnMarkerTarget :85`, `STATION_RETURN_INSTALL_REACH :137`). Do not reimplement either transaction.

New `state:` refs need a producer in `story/storyBoundaryTelemetry.ts` (`deriveStoryBoundaryState :120`, `readStoryBoundaryRuntime :208`, `publishStoryBoundaryTelemetry :264`) **before** the gate allowlist `SUPPORTED_STATE_REF_PATTERNS` (`chapter-registry-gate.mjs:27`) gains a pattern. `main/story-authority.json` (`runtimeBeatOrder`, `runtimeEvidenceChain`, `activeProduction`, `openReleaseGates`) and `chapter-journey-contract.json` are updated only after signature; the demo ceiling at `ch4-arrival` is untouched.

Generator order: create `beats/ch13/index.ts` → `npm run chapter:registry:generate` → hand-add the `ch13` registry record and the `beats/index.ts` import → `chapter:registry:check`, `chapter:journey:check`.

## 7. Rail seams: station movie → depart → flight → Tidegarden → install → next chapter

Pinned current behavior: `App.enterSpaceStation` strips `story`, `movie` and debug flags before the hard navigation — **a rehearsal `story=<beat>` must never be reintroduced or the completed save is reseeded**. `SpaceStationSandbox.onSequenceComplete` persists departure and returns with `undock`/`fly`; `spaceStationUndock.ts::{parseUndockFlag :22, requestedUndockAddress :39, searchAfterUndockConsumed :49, undockedShipPose :66}` consumes those one-shot directives. `StationScreeningDriver.tsx` currently ends after cell acquisition + dwell.

Required seam work, all bounded, each reporting `stuck` rather than rescuing:
`stationmovie=1` → real airlock/depart action → screening-intent carry-over on the return URL **without** `story=` → `undock`/`fly` reconstruction → flight/landing rail → real `installTidegardenBondedCell` F action in `world/TidegardenSettlementWorld.tsx` → invitation choice at the certified-home core → ch13 entry watch. Then retire the old dock bridge: `autopilot/primitives.ts::isMovieStationBridgeActive` (`:1732`) currently stays eligible whenever ch10 is complete; it must yield once departure/return supersedes it. Rails derive from `autopilot/rails.ts::BEAT_RAILS` (`:5`); `beats/railDiscipline.test.ts` pins a 29-file census — update it honestly.

## 8. Score and signed AV

`commonGroundScore.ts` calls only the existing facade: `storyScore.ts::{setScoreBeat :1017, getStoryScoreMood :972, setStoryScoreMoodOverride :993, unlockStoryScore :967, resetStoryScoreRuntime :1032, setScoreIntensity/scoreHit (re-export :965)}`, plus `MOOD_TONIC_CHAINS :594` / `TONIC_CHAIN_POLICY :606` rows. Follow `emergentScoreDirector.ts` as the pattern for reselect-on-reload without replaying hits. The ≤5 s live-only coda is the one required new behavior: today deactivation clears score immediately, so ch13 needs an explicit chapter-local presentation hold that hands to the existing 4.5 s release fade, cancels on every signed trigger, and never defers/hydrates/replays. No new hit anchor in `STORY_HIT_ANCHORS` (`:538`); no engine graph.

Signed AV registration is two mirrored inventories plus one JSON: `tools/generate-scene-av-runtime.mjs::SIGNED_SOURCES` and `story/signedSceneAvRuntime.ts::SIGNED_SCENE_AV_SOURCES` (`:49`, with per-scene sha/revision constants and the anchor census), then `npm run scene:av:generate` / `scene:av:check` regenerating `generatedSceneAvRuntime.json`. Commits publish moments through `activateSignedSceneSemanticEvent` (`:850`) / `activateSignedSceneAnchorById` (`:844`); `enterSignedSceneAvBeat` (`:785`), `tickSignedSceneAvRuntime` (`:855`) and `resetSignedSceneAvRuntime` (`:903`) retain beat/pause/reset ownership.

## 9. Behavioral test holes (new) and existing anchors to extend

New: `commonGroundState.test.ts` (capacity, corner preservation, tested-prefix/tail-revision, wrong actor/world, absent/legacy/malformed hydration, clear scope), `commonGroundRoute.test.ts` (trunk-solid guard, unsupported vs out-of-range vs occluded reasons, hold-at-last-safe, replan on terrain revision), `commonGroundDirector.test.ts` (one semantic acknowledgement per objective entry, marker/work-order parity, idempotent commit, reciprocal precondition), `commonGroundScore.test.ts` (coda cancellation matrix, no replay on hydrate).
Extend: `beats/allContracts.test.ts`, `beatRegistry.test.ts`, `railDiscipline.test.ts`, `screeningParity.test.ts`, `auditWorkerPresence.test.ts`, `storyInteractions.test.ts`, `storyState.test.ts`, `persistence.test.ts`, `stationReturnStory.test.ts`, `spaceStationStory.test.ts`, `spaceStationUndock.test.ts`, `storyBoundaryTelemetry.test.ts`, `agentSurfaceNavigation*.test.ts`, `groundedSurfaceMotion.test.ts`.

## 10. Remaining dependencies before an engineer can start

1. Selected instrument range (12 vs 24) and socket assignment — three-lane reconciliation, unsigned.
2. Arena coordinates and the two route classes' proof that they meet the ≥12-unit / ≥25% / ≥6-unit-unsupported floor — pass-2 says the current arena does **not**; do not freeze it.
3. Trace caps, spacing, corner threshold, witness radii/tolerances as contract constants.
4. Exact objective ids, marker labels, work-order copy, feedback ids (Chapter's four `guidanceReplacements` supersede earlier wording).
5. The chosen external-transition schema shape signed into the registry schema + gate.
6. Signed scene contract sha/revision for the AV inventories and the registry `sceneContracts` entry.
7. Owner-delegated decision recorded after the three signatures; production lock moved off `planning-only`.

# Common Ground — implementation interface plan (ch13)

Preparation only, 2026-09-06. No runtime/main source edit, no build, test, probe or signature was performed. Symbols below were read from the live worktree (including untracked `beats/` and `autopilot/`), not from the older survey. Geometry numbers (selected instrument range, socket assignment, arena coordinates, exact sample/route layout) are **deferred input** from the signed scene contract; nothing here selects them. This plan assumes the accepted direction only and proposes no creative content.

## 0. Rules for the one integration engineer

Namespaced chapter-local modules; each shared file receives a **single small call**, no refactor of `storyState.ts`, `emergentStoryDirector.ts`, `storyDirector.ts`, `App.tsx`, `EfficientScene.tsx`, `EfficientPlayer.tsx`. All of those are dirty; re-check `ls -l` immediately before edit and never reset/stash. Score uses the existing `storyScore.ts` facade only — no engine graph, no new instrument, no bundle.

## 1. New chapter-local files (all new; no existing file moves)

| File | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundState.ts` | Versioned bounded trace state + reducers + serialize/hydrate/migrate/reset. Pure, no React, no world imports. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundRoute.ts` | Prop/solid-aware grounded route validation and the walked-prefix predicate. Pure over injected terrain/solid queries. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundDirector.ts` | Live tick/enter dispatch, objective facts, commit events, marker target, interaction resolver registration. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundScore.ts` | ch13 mood/variant table + the live-only coda allowance, expressed through `storyScore` APIs. |
| `main/src/story/commonGroundActor.ts` | The single ch13 writer of W-7744's pose + presence branch. |
| `main/src/story/world/CommonGroundWorld.tsx` | Chapter-scoped world component: trace render, fixed plate, world handles registration, save restore/clear boundary. |
| `main/src/story/beats/ch13/{ch13-home,ch13-return,ch13-survey,ch13-common}.ts` | Four `defineBeat` contracts; filename === beat id. |
| `main/src/story/beats/ch13/{index.ts,definitions.ts}` | **`index.ts` must exist before the first generator run** (`emit` reads before write). |
| `main/src/story/autopilot/rail-ch13-*.ts` | Rails; move/look/act only. |
| `*.test.ts` beside each | See §8. |

## 2. Finite bounded trace state — `commonGroundState.ts`

Exported surface (proposed, exact):

```ts
export const COMMON_GROUND_SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 1;
export interface TraceSample { x: number; y: number; z: number; corner: boolean }
export interface TraceSlot {
  id: 'accepted' | 'working';
  samples: readonly TraceSample[];  // <= MAX_SAMPLES
  lengthUnits: number;              // <= MAX_TRACE_UNITS
  testedPrefixCount: number;        // samples proven by an actual test
  tailRevision: number;             // monotonic; bumps only on tail edit
  offeredEndIndex: number | null;
}
export interface CommonGroundSnapshot {
  version: typeof COMMON_GROUND_SNAPSHOT_VERSION;
  actorId: string; worldId: string;
  slots: Readonly<Record<'accepted' | 'working', TraceSlot | null>>;
  witness: { index: number; offered: boolean } | null;   // at most one
  reciprocal: { held: boolean } | null;
  hold: { reason: 'out-of-range' | 'unsupported' | 'occluded' | null };
  safePose: TraceSample | null;
}
createEmptySnapshot(actorId, worldId)
appendSample(s, sample)          // honest stop at capacity
reviseTail(s, fromIndex)         // preserves testedPrefixCount, bumps tailRevision
invalidateTestedPrefix(s, from)  // only on real voxel/support change
clearUncommitted(s)              // explicit proposal reset only
serializeCommonGround(s) / hydrateCommonGround(raw, actorId, worldId)
migrateCommonGround(raw)         // absent/legacy -> null, never throws
```

Invariants tests must pin: capacity stop never decimates a recorded corner; `reviseTail` never lowers `testedPrefixCount`; wrong `actorId`/`worldId` hydrates to `null`, not a partial graft; `clearUncommitted` never touches `accepted`; pause / failed input / Continue never call it.

**Numeric constants (`MAX_SAMPLES`, `MAX_TRACE_UNITS`, spacing, corner threshold, witness radii/tolerances, selected instrument range, socket heights) are declared as named exports with no committed values in this plan.** They are contract-supplied.

## 3. Persistence seam — `main/src/game/systems/persistence.ts`

Precedent to copy exactly is `WorldSave.habitat` (`persistence.ts:239`, snapshot at `:253`, restore at `:301`). Minimal change:

- add `commonGround?: unknown` to the `WorldSave` interface;
- write it in `saveWorld` beside `habitat`, guarded by `worldId`;
- add `restoreCommonGroundForWorld(world: WorldSaveRef)` and `clearCommonGroundForWorld(world: WorldSaveRef)` alongside `restoreHabitatForWorld` / `clearCampfiresForWorld`;
- `clearWorldStateForWorld` clears it for **that world only**.

No `GlobalSave` change. Ledgers (`observationLedger`, `accomplishmentLedger`) are optional evidence only and must not gate progression. `restartStory()` (`storyState.ts:775`) must be given an explicit ch13 clear call; it does not clear ledgers today.

## 4. Actor: single pose writer, prop-aware grounded route

- `AuditWorker.tsx` renders `getAuditWorkerPose()`; keep it as the only body. `commonGroundActor.ts` becomes the sole writer while a ch13 beat is active (`A4WorldChoreography` writes only during `a4-exhale`; do not overlap).
- `auditWorkerPresence.ts::shouldMountAuditWorker` (single export, `:11`) needs one extra explicit ch13 branch, independent of `FIELD_PACK_DROPPED_MILESTONE`. A4's pack/absence proof must stay green.
- Routing reuses, unmodified: `utils/agentSurfaceNavigationRuntime.ts::createLiveAgentSurfaceTerrain` (`:13`), `utils/agentSurfaceNavigation.ts::planAgentSurfaceRoute` (`:305`, with `AgentSurfaceRouteOptions` / `AgentSurfaceRouteReason` / `AgentSurfaceRoute`), and `utils/groundedSurfaceMotion.ts::{groundedSurfaceRouteLength, sampleGroundedSurfaceRoute, turnGroundedHeadingToward}`.
- **Known gap (pass-2 finding):** the voxel planner does not know the real trunk collider and can plan through it. The correction belongs in `commonGroundRoute.ts` as a solid-occluder guard layered over `planAgentSurfaceRoute`, not in the shared navigation module and not in worldgen. Unreachable/unsupported/out-of-range must return distinct typed reasons and produce a hold at the last safe sample — never a teleport or a timer-derived success.

## 5. Dormant reactivation and live dispatch (four one-line seams)

1. `StoryDirectorDriver.tsx` — beside the existing `!story.active` branch that calls `tickChapter10FreePlayEntry` (`:181`) and publishes `stationReturnObjective` (`:146`), add one bounded `tickCommonGroundEntry(...)` call. It must call `reactivateStoryAtBeat('ch13-home')` (`storyState.ts:821`), never `advanceToBeat` (`:808`, leaves `active:false`).
2. `emergentStoryDirector.ts` — `enterEmergentStoryBeat` (`:645`) and `emergentStoryDirectorTick` (`:787`) each get one ch13 dispatch line preserving the existing guidance-clear + signed-AV-enter semantics and the publication gate in `syncEmergentObjectiveGuidance`.
3. `storyState.ts` — `storyEntryPoint()` (`:246`) gains ch13 resume clauses **before** the `ch10Complete` clause and must return `alive` reality explicitly (else falls through to `bare`); `STORY_BEAT_ORDER` (`:333`) gains the four ids before `done`; `StoryChapter`/`StoryBeat` unions and `STORY_MILESTONES` (`:120`) gain ch13 rows. Keep `done` last.
4. `beats/index.ts` — add the `ch13` import (the generator does not add it).

Objective facts extend `beats/objectivePrimitives.ts::StoryObjectiveGuidanceFacts` (`:84`) with a compact ch13 fact block plus defaults in `DEFAULT_STORY_OBJECTIVE_GUIDANCE_FACTS` (`:116`); ch13 objective prose/resolvers live in `beats/ch13/`, not in `objectivePrimitives.ts`.

Marker: extend `beats/worldHandles.ts::WorldMarkerHandle` (`:9`) with the ch13 targets and resolve through `beats/markerTargets.ts::resolveMarkerTarget` (`:20`); `registerStoryMarkerWorld` (`:10`) is called from `CommonGroundWorld.tsx`. One marker authority; no new overlay.

Interaction: add ids to `game/systems/interactionSystem.ts::InteractionId` (`:9`, must match `story-${string}` for `StoryInteractionId`), extend the exhaustive policy in `story/storyInteractions.ts`, and register one world-scoped resolver via `registerStoryInteraction` (`:287`) with explicit priority/class/owner and cleanup. No player-loop or key change; build mode keeps F.

## 6. Registered ch13 beats and the strict EXTERNAL boundary

Four contracts via `beats/beatContract.ts::defineBeat` (`:73`); `entry: 'reactivation-from-done'` for `ch13-home`, `'sequence'` for the rest; every `rail` declares `stuckAfterSeconds` and `waitReason` and may not grant/mark/advance.

`chapter-registry.json` (`main/chapter-registry.json`, keys `schema | runtimeAuthorityRef | terminalBeat | sceneContracts | chapters`) gets a `ch13` record with `order: 11` (array position, not chapter number), `beats`, `before: ['ch10']`, `entry`, `exit`, `checkpoints`, `objectiveRefs`, `revealRefs`, and a new `sceneContracts` entry.

`tools/chapter-registry-gate.mjs::validateAdjacency` requires exact predecessor-exit / next-entry `stateRefs` equality. Ch10's real exit is `state:control/flight` + `state:space-station/{targeted}` + `state:station/docking-authorized`; ch13's real entry is restored hearth, on-foot Origin, station departed. **Do not add false guarantees to ch10 and do not drop true ch13 entry requirements.** Add a named `externalTransitions` entry type to the registry + its schema + the gate, of the shape:

```
{ id: 'ch10->ch13-via-station', from: {chapter:'ch10', exitBeat:'ch10-transit'},
  to: {chapter:'ch13', entryBeat:'ch13-home'},
  hostSegments: ['station(ch11)', 'return(ch12)'],
  producedReceipts: ['story:ch11-docked','story:ch11-bonded-cell-acquired',
                     'story:ch12-bonded-cell-installed','story:ch12-hearth-restored'],
  entryGuarantees: [...], evidenceRefs: [...] }
```

Ordinary chapter-to-chapter adjacency checks stay strict and unchanged; the transition proves both boundaries independently. Receipt strings stay byte-identical — they are owned by `game/spaceStation/spaceStationStory.ts::STATION_STORY_MILESTONES` (`:29`, with `bootstrapStationStorySession :108`, `deriveStationStoryStep :134`, `commitStationDeparted :201`, `issueBondedCell :179`) and `story/stationReturnStory.ts::STATION_RETURN_MILESTONES` (`:16`, with `installTidegardenBondedCell :109`, `stationReturnPending :39`, `stationReturnObjective :56`, `stationReturnMarkerTarget :85`, `STATION_RETURN_INSTALL_REACH :137`). Do not reimplement either transaction.

New `state:` refs need a producer in `story/storyBoundaryTelemetry.ts` (`deriveStoryBoundaryState :120`, `readStoryBoundaryRuntime :208`, `publishStoryBoundaryTelemetry :264`) **before** the gate allowlist `SUPPORTED_STATE_REF_PATTERNS` (`chapter-registry-gate.mjs:27`) gains a pattern. `main/story-authority.json` (`runtimeBeatOrder`, `runtimeEvidenceChain`, `activeProduction`, `openReleaseGates`) and `chapter-journey-contract.json` are updated only after signature; the demo ceiling at `ch4-arrival` is untouched.

Generator order: create `beats/ch13/index.ts` → `npm run chapter:registry:generate` → hand-add the `ch13` registry record and the `beats/index.ts` import → `chapter:registry:check`, `chapter:journey:check`.

## 7. Rail seams: station movie → depart → flight → Tidegarden → install → next chapter

Pinned current behavior: `App.enterSpaceStation` strips `story`, `movie` and debug flags before the hard navigation — **a rehearsal `story=<beat>` must never be reintroduced or the completed save is reseeded**. `SpaceStationSandbox.onSequenceComplete` persists departure and returns with `undock`/`fly`; `spaceStationUndock.ts::{parseUndockFlag :22, requestedUndockAddress :39, searchAfterUndockConsumed :49, undockedShipPose :66}` consumes those one-shot directives. `StationScreeningDriver.tsx` currently ends after cell acquisition + dwell.

Required seam work, all bounded, each reporting `stuck` rather than rescuing:
`stationmovie=1` → real airlock/depart action → screening-intent carry-over on the return URL **without** `story=` → `undock`/`fly` reconstruction → flight/landing rail → real `installTidegardenBondedCell` F action in `world/TidegardenSettlementWorld.tsx` → invitation choice at the certified-home core → ch13 entry watch. Then retire the old dock bridge: `autopilot/primitives.ts::isMovieStationBridgeActive` (`:1732`) currently stays eligible whenever ch10 is complete; it must yield once departure/return supersedes it. Rails derive from `autopilot/rails.ts::BEAT_RAILS` (`:5`); `beats/railDiscipline.test.ts` pins a 29-file census — update it honestly.

## 8. Score and signed AV

`commonGroundScore.ts` calls only the existing facade: `storyScore.ts::{setScoreBeat :1017, getStoryScoreMood :972, setStoryScoreMoodOverride :993, unlockStoryScore :967, resetStoryScoreRuntime :1032, setScoreIntensity/scoreHit (re-export :965)}`, plus `MOOD_TONIC_CHAINS :594` / `TONIC_CHAIN_POLICY :606` rows. Follow `emergentScoreDirector.ts` as the pattern for reselect-on-reload without replaying hits. The ≤5 s live-only coda is the one required new behavior: today deactivation clears score immediately, so ch13 needs an explicit chapter-local presentation hold that hands to the existing 4.5 s release fade, cancels on every signed trigger, and never defers/hydrates/replays. No new hit anchor in `STORY_HIT_ANCHORS` (`:538`); no engine graph.

Signed AV registration is two mirrored inventories plus one JSON: `tools/generate-scene-av-runtime.mjs::SIGNED_SOURCES` and `story/signedSceneAvRuntime.ts::SIGNED_SCENE_AV_SOURCES` (`:49`, with per-scene sha/revision constants and the anchor census), then `npm run scene:av:generate` / `scene:av:check` regenerating `generatedSceneAvRuntime.json`. Commits publish moments through `activateSignedSceneSemanticEvent` (`:850`) / `activateSignedSceneAnchorById` (`:844`); `enterSignedSceneAvBeat` (`:785`), `tickSignedSceneAvRuntime` (`:855`) and `resetSignedSceneAvRuntime` (`:903`) retain beat/pause/reset ownership.

## 9. Behavioral test holes (new) and existing anchors to extend

New: `commonGroundState.test.ts` (capacity, corner preservation, tested-prefix/tail-revision, wrong actor/world, absent/legacy/malformed hydration, clear scope); `commonGroundRoute.test.ts` (trunk-solid guard, three distinct refusal reasons, hold-at-last-safe, replan on terrain revision); `commonGroundDirector.test.ts` (one acknowledgement per objective entry, marker/work-order parity, idempotent commit, reciprocal precondition); `commonGroundScore.test.ts` (coda cancellation matrix, no replay on hydrate).
Extend: `allContracts`, `beatRegistry`, `railDiscipline`, `screeningParity`, `auditWorkerPresence`, `storyInteractions`, `storyState`, `persistence`, `stationReturnStory`, `spaceStationStory`, `spaceStationUndock`, `storyBoundaryTelemetry`, `agentSurfaceNavigation*`, `groundedSurfaceMotion`.

## 10. Remaining dependencies before an engineer can start

1. Selected instrument range (12 vs 24) and socket assignment — three-lane reconciliation, unsigned.
2. Arena coordinates and the two route classes' proof that they meet the ≥12-unit / ≥25% / ≥6-unit-unsupported floor — pass-2 says the current arena does **not**; do not freeze it.
3. Trace caps, spacing, corner threshold, witness radii/tolerances as contract constants.
4. Exact objective ids, marker labels, work-order copy, feedback ids (Chapter's four `guidanceReplacements` supersede earlier wording).
5. The chosen external-transition schema shape signed into the registry schema + gate.
6. Signed scene contract sha/revision for the AV inventories and the registry `sceneContracts` entry.
7. Owner-delegated decision recorded after the three signatures; production lock moved off `planning-only`.
